By collecting student projects, and sharing them on various social network platforms, I was able to learn how many people might be interested in similar concepts of the creative expression of young people in relation to technology. Of course it would be wrong to suggest that ‘young people are dumb’- or to make assumptions about them as an audience or audience of people. So, I decided that I would use this tool of online ‘social sharing’ as a way to gauge interest and get some feedback.\\\\n\\\\nThis first report is the result of this process, from a single project and set of eight selected video images.
